data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Christos' meaning 'anointed one'. The name Christiana signifies a person who is devoted to Christ. The name Christiana carries the meaning “Follower of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Christiana usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: Christiana represents a sacred bond between an individual and their faith, embodying a strong spiritual commitment to follow the teachings and ways of Jesus Christ.
